name: codex
title: Codex / GPT cross-vendor interface
summary: Adds the OpenAI-backed half of the harness: cross-vendor code review through the Codex CLI, opt-in OpenAI executors (Terra standard tier, Sol heavy tier) through the same CLI, and the two-architect /cross-compare-plan session (independent drafts, cross-critique, blind synthesis) whose GPT lane runs read-only through the same CLI.

bin: codex (Codex CLI) — for reviewer-codex, the executor-codex tiers, and the cross-compare architect lane
env: OPENAI_API_KEY or `codex login` — review, execution, and cross-compare

notes: Executor engine: set "executorEngine": "codex" to route execution to the OpenAI executors (Terra/Sol); the Claude executors remain the fallback and escalation rung.

Recommended pin for review: ORCHESTRA_REVIEW_MODEL=gpt-5.6-sol. Execution defaults: gpt-5.6-terra (standard), gpt-5.6-sol (heavy). Cross-compare GPT-lane default: gpt-5.6-sol at high effort (ORCHESTRA_CROSSPLAN_MODEL / ORCHESTRA_CROSSPLAN_EFFORT).

Windows: codex-command-runner.exe, codex-resources AND codex-windows-sandbox-setup.exe must sit DIRECTLY beside codex.exe. Codex resolves the sandbox helper by name, so a copy one directory down (inside codex-resources\) is never found — the sandbox is never set up and BOTH lanes (review and execution) return nothing while looking healthy. The self-check below finds that state and repairs it where it can.
Without this pack the harness still gets full fresh-context Opus review and Claude execution; it just has no cross-vendor option.
